items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Richard Seidel, oh, man. He thinks he discovered me... He came all the way to Boston. I was there to do the Boston, the song with the Boston Pops... He came to bribe me, and he did, bribe me to put his name, bribe me with a little machine so he could put his name on as producer.

ctx.x: That‘s right. We had a complete blowout, the biggest night here. So I had candles and we just worked the bar. [laughs] Everybody had a good time. Richard Seidel was here.
